name: stale-context-edit
description: Fix the catalog page size against the changelog and tests despite stale README/comment context.
prompt: The catalog test suite currently fails. The README and the code comment describe a 20-item page size, but CHANGELOG.md records that v2.0.0 raised the page size to 50, and the test expects 50. Make `python3 tests/test_catalog.py` print ok. Do not modify the tests.
